keyframe_review.note: New keyframe, the Cliopatria 'Kingdom of Naples' shape of 1501 (68,688 km2 at most) reused. Area check: the page gives no area, only that the territory 'corresponded to the current Italian regions of Campania, Calabria, Apulia' and ~3 million people in 1600, so the shape is a reading. The Presidi (1557) are in their own dossier, state-of-the-presidi; Sicily and Sardinia were separate Spanish kingdoms.

region.text: the Kingdom of Naples on mainland southern Italy, 'the current Italian regions of Campania, Calabria, Apulia' and neighbours

ledger.note: 1504: Ferdinand of Aragon holds all Naples. 'The resulting Aragonese victory left Ferdinand in full control of the kingdom by 1504'; infobox 'Viceroyalty of the Spanish Empire (1504-1714)'; Gonzalo Fernandez de Cordoba is viceroy from 1504 (Viceroyalty page). France had partitioned the kingdom with Aragon in 1501, and 'Aragon and France resumed their war over the kingdom in 1502'.

region.text: Naples, where the people 'rose in revolt in 1647'

ledger.note: 7 July 1647: Masaniello's revolt begins in Naples. 'the people of Naples rose in revolt in 1647, forming the Neapolitan Republic with French assistance'; the infobox gives 'Neapolitan rebellion: 7 July 1647'. The revolt's area is not on the page.

region.text: Naples, where John of Austria was sent to crush the revolt

ledger.note: 1648: the revolt is crushed. The viceroy list: John of Austria (January-March 1648) 'sent to Naples to crush the Neapolitan Revolt'; the Kingdom page has it 'suppressed later that year' (1647) by Spanish troops.

July 1707: Austrian rule begins. The Viceroyalty page lists Georg Adam von Martinitz as viceroy for July-October 1707 under King Joseph I and heads the list 'Austrian rule (1707-1734)'; the Kingdom page gives the Treaty of Rastatt of 7 March 1714 ('Naples was given to Charles VI') and the infobox 'Part of the Habsburg monarchy (1714-1735)'. The overlord changes from Spain to the Habsburgs; the dossier continues.

sources.title: Viceroyalty of Naples
sources.note: A list of viceroys: 'Under the Crown of Aragon (1504-1707)', 'Austrian rule (1707-1734)', John of Austria 1648. No narrative.

notes: A colony-type dossier for the Spanish and then Austrian rule of the mainland south, which the group scope asked for; written from two pages (the Viceroyalty page is only a list of viceroys). Unsettled: the 1504 start (the Treaty of Lyon and Garigliano are on no page opened), the end of the Spanish phase (1707 on the viceroy list, 1713-1714 for Utrecht and Rastatt on the Kingdom page, where the infobox gives the viceroyalty as 1504-1714 and the Habsburg monarchy 1714-1735), the area and the borders (the Cliopatria 1501 shape is reused), and whether the Habsburg Monarchy dossier of eu-09 already draws Naples in 1714-1734 (check for double drawing). The suzerain relation (Spain until 1707, the Habsburgs after) should be a vassal_start/vassal_end pair with counterpart viceroyalty-of-naples in the dossiers of kingdom-of-spain (or crown-of-aragon) and habsburg-monarchy; this dossier does not record it. Sicily under Spain and Austria and Sardinia under Spain are not covered. The State of the Presidi, administered by the viceroy, has its own dossier. Gazetteer names: none.
